import json,subprocess,math
p='analysis/render-queue-2026-10-28/'
def pixels(name):return subprocess.check_output(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-i',p+name+'.png','-pix_fmt','rgb24','-f','rawvideo','-'])
a,b=pixels('before-frame'),pixels('after-frame');rms=math.sqrt(sum((x-y)**2 for x,y in zip(a,b))/len(a));print('Matched-frame RMS difference:',rms)
s=json.load(open(p+'live.json'));s['matchedFrameRms']=rms;s['downloadVerified']=True;json.dump(s,open(p+'live.json','w'),indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)
